objects.description: [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has used a hybrid AES-256-GCM and RSA OAEP-SHA256 encryption to archive gathered data. [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has also utilized custom MD5-keystream XOR cipher to encrypt data.(Citation: Trend Micro TeamPCP MAY 2026) [Mini Shai-Hulud](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9043) has also been deployed via an obfuscated script using Bun JavaScript runtime.(Citation: Flashpoint Mini Shai-Hulud MAY 2026)
